flags.headline: Q2 miss (8/6) remains thesis-confirmed; modest bounce today does not offset cumulative decline
flags.detail: MARA reported a $611M net loss and $343M BTC mark-to-market hit on 8/6, triggering a ~-15% multi-session decline. Today the stock is +1.31% ($9.675 vs $9.55 prev close) on no specific new catalyst found -- reads as a technical bounce within a still-depressed range, not a reversal of the thesis-relevant risk.
flags.thesis_link: Matches MARA key_risk: 'Persistent GAAP losses driven by Bitcoin price volatility and mark-to-market accounting create existential risk if crypto enters a prolonged downturn and the company cannot service its $850M convertible debt obligations.' The Q2 loss is that risk materializing, not a new development.

flags.headline: Aug 31 wildfire-reform deadline 19 days out, no legislative movement; CEO has publicly warned of credit downgrades
flags.detail: Edison International CEO Pedro Pizarro has warned that failure to pass a credit-supportive wildfire liability/affordability framework by California's Aug 31 end-of-session deadline would likely trigger credit-rating downgrades for SCE, whose S&P rating is already at the lowest investment-grade notch, pushing it into junk territory and raising customer financing costs. No new legislative action found today. Stock is +3.08% today ($69.88) -- the market is not currently pricing in downgrade risk, but the structural catalyst and deadline are unchanged.
flags.thesis_link: Matches EIX key_risk: 'Elevated debt-to-equity of 216% amplifies financial risk from future wildfire events, adverse rate case outcomes, or rising interest rates... California's complex regulatory and political environment creates uncertainty around cost recovery, rate base returns, and wildfire liability frameworks.'
